summary: The import sanity test only sees the standard library, so a module can work in playbooks and tests yet fail it; all ImportErrors must be handled in the code.
questions: Why does the import sanity test fail when my module works fine?

answer_card.title: ImportError but module works
answer_card.answer_md: By design the test sees only the Python standard library, so code that works in playbooks, unit and integration tests can still fail. Handle every `ImportError` in the module or plugin.
